class.name: SteamAudioListener
class.brief_description: This node's transform is used for simulating the listener's transform in the SteamAudio simulation. You'll likely want to have this as a child of your [Camera3D].
class.description: Exactly one active listener is supported. The most recently entered listener becomes active, and removing any listener clears the server listener, so do not keep multiple listener nodes in the running scene.

members.member: Minimum source-to-surface distance in meters used to limit reflected-energy calculations for real-time reflections.
Ambisonic order used by real-time reflection simulation. Higher orders improve directional detail at increased CPU and memory cost. Clamped to [member SteamAudioConfig.max_ambisonics_order].
Maximum number of geometry bounces for real-time reflection rays. Higher values produce longer, more accurate tails at increased simulation cost.

Length in seconds of real-time reflection impulse responses. Longer durations model longer reverb tails at increased memory and convolution cost. Clamped to [member SteamAudioConfig.max_reflection_duration].
Number of rays traced for real-time reflection simulation. Higher values reduce noise and improve accuracy at increased CPU cost. Clamped to [member SteamAudioConfig.max_reflection_rays].
